comparison.name: zs_lane_v1 (live production lane, Z3 + Z2 pooled GBM + D1 snap)

budget.rule: a scan with more triangles than max_faces (file header) runs on a resampling of itself on a fixed absolute grid (cell cell_mm x 1.12^k, the smallest k whose output has at most max_faces faces): one QEF vertex per (cell, skin) from the scan's grid-line crossings, one quad per crossing (budget.py, revision 3); within the budget the scan is used unchanged

primary.command: research/zeroshot/zs_lane_v3/run_cohort.sh <scan_list.tsv> docs/production/runlog/zeroshot_2026-10-25/newscans_<batch>/runs/v3 0 1   (each scan through tools/guarded_slot.sh, --strict-pins: refuses on any pin mismatch or unpinned module)
primary.name: zs_lane_v3 revision 3 (zs_lane_v2 + EXT + Z3R; exact bounded Z3 merge, Z2 before Z3, density-invariant 3M-face budget: fixed-grid resampling, cell 0.30 mm)

cohort.minimum_size_for_a_decision: at least 10 complete-label line scans from at least 5 families; below that the run is descriptive only and the default stays zs_lane_v1
cohort.rule: NEW_UNSEEN_FAMILY_TEST: the families must not be in DEV, DEV-CHECK, FRESH, TEST-B or N1 (check family ids and sha256 against INVENTORY.json, SPLIT_FROZEN.json and newscans_N1/REGISTRY.json). Nothing may be tuned, calibrated or selected on these scans. No v3 parameter, threshold, model or rule changes after this file is ledgered.
cohort.source: fresh scans expected from the customer; never seen by any lane

context_not_a_decision_input.n1: consumed (post-hoc diagnosis only); never a v3 score
context_not_a_decision_input.v3_disclosure: the EXT / Z3R parameters were set on all-DEV OOF prototypes (selection-aware); the containment value 0.6 is the middle of the DEV plateau (0.5-0.75), not the N1-aware 0.75; see research/zeroshot/zs_lane_v3/README.md
context_not_a_decision_input.v3_rev2: revision 2 is runtime/memory only: DEV OOF with the v3 fold models 0.9660, 597/20/22, control FP 1 (identical to revision 1); full refit procedure 0.9651, 595/19/24, control FP 1 (paired -0.0009 [-0.0055, +0.0032]); see v3/rev2/FREEZE_REV2.md
context_not_a_decision_input.v3_rev3: revision 3 changes the budget step only (density-invariant fixed-grid resampling above 3M faces): DEV OOF with the v3 fold models 0.9660, 597/20/22, control FP 1, rolled FP 0 (identical to revisions 1 and 2; 119/119 unbudgeted DEV dumps bit-identical, the 6 budgeted scans keep their TP/FP/FN); full refit procedure 0.9612, 595/24/24, control FP 1 (refit noise, all count changes on unbudgeted scans; models are not refit); densified DEV scans A-D up to 46M faces: every native-density line reproduced; see v3/rev3/FREEZE_REV3.md

gold_rule.labels: <FILL IN before ledgering> {sid: {path, sha256, ledger_seq, ledger_entry_sha256, part_id}}
gold_rule.rule: GOLD IS FROZEN BEFORE ANY RUN. Gold is marked blind by two markers plus adjudication with a canary (gold/MARKER_HOWTO.md, as gold/N1), REGISTERED and FROZEN in gold/GOLD_LEDGER.jsonl with tools/gold_ledger_newscans.py (labels only in data/bend_corpus/annotations/ai_bend_lines_newscans_<batch>_v1/), and only then is this PREREG filled and ledgered. The gold guard (research/zeroshot/common/gold_guard.py, pinned in every lane fingerprint) refuses any scan that is not FROZEN, so a lane cannot run first. Gold is never edited after the run.

metrics.controls: zero-bend scans (gold 0 lines, disposition ZERO_BEND_CONTROL) and rolled shells reported separately as FP lines per arm
metrics.failed_scans: a missing or FAILED output = empty prediction (all gold FN; on a control 0 FP); no scan is dropped, no re-run
metrics.family_macro: mean over part families of the family-micro F1
metrics.micro: summed TP/FP/FN over complete-label line scans
metrics.paired: v3 - v1 paired family bootstrap of micro and family-macro (n 10000, seed 20261025), families better / worse
metrics.runtime: wall time and peak RSS per process from run_record.json

amendments.after: v3 per-process wall P95 <= 60 s and peak RSS < 32 GiB (owner amendment 2026-10-25; the runner's zs limits are 90 s and the engine's RSS cap, 32 GiB under ENGINE_IO-A5)
amendments.before: v3 per-process wall P95 <= 60 s and peak RSS < 4 GiB (the runner's zs limits are 90 s / 4 GiB)
amendments.by: owner (2026-10-25): approved changing the memory clause from 'peak RSS < 4 GiB' to '< 32 GiB' with the production per-step cap raise (ENGINE_IO-A5: one-job station, 256 GB RAM, 5-50 M-point ZEISS ScanBox scans)
amendments.note: ENGINE_IO-A5 (the runner cap 4 -> 32 GiB) is PROPOSED, not yet in force: contracts/production/line_job.py is a pinned file of every zs lane pin, so raising the cap needs an owner decision on re-pinning; until then the runner's zs RSS limit is still 4 GiB and a v3 run above 4 GiB would be killed (no overlay) in production
amendments.scope: memory clause only; the P95 <= 60 s clause and every other clause are unchanged; no fresh run had happened
amendments.supersedes: the memory clause of freeze-ledger seq 21

flip_allowed_if_all: v3 - v1 paired micro point estimate >= 0
v3 control + rolled FP lines <= v1 control + rolled FP lines
0 FAILED or refused v3 outputs (pins_ok on every scan)
v3 per-process wall P95 <= 60 s and peak RSS < 32 GiB (owner amendment 2026-10-25; the runner's zs limits are 90 s and the engine's RSS cap, 32 GiB under ENGINE_IO-A5)
proposed_decision_rule.otherwise: the default stays zs_lane_v1; the result is recorded, nothing is re-run or tuned

purpose: one-time test of zs_lane_v3 (primary) against zs_lane_v1 (live production lane, comparison) on fresh customer scans of never-seen part families; it decides whether pin.DEFAULT_LANE may be flipped to zs_lane_v3 (v3/REPIN_PLAN.md)
run_procedure: gold FROZEN (gold ledger) -> this file filled -> freeze-ledger NOTE 'PRE-REGISTRATION' (binds this file's sha256) -> freeze-ledger RUN entry (tier NEW_UNSEEN_FAMILY_TEST, seedset, case_ids_sha256) -> one run per arm per scan -> score -> RESULTS + freeze-ledger NOTE binding the RESULTS sha256
each arm x scan exactly once, through tools/guarded_slot.sh (gold guard, one geometry slot, OMP 1); at most 3 concurrent geometry jobs, process-tree RSS < 16 GiB
a crash is recorded, not retried

scorer.driver: research/zeroshot/zs_lane_v2/scoring.py score_scan + aggregate (unchanged; v3's scorer fingerprint), the same call for both arms
scorer.matcher: research/broad_baseline/score.py score_case (frozen): 5 deg / 4 mm / 0.6 of both spans (gold and prediction), one-to-one Hungarian, apex locus, raw scan frame
